insights.text: Vuori is uniquely balanced: 45% women's / 38% men's. Alo skews 53% women's, Gymshark 22% men's.
Vuori's earth tone palette (15%) is +8% vs industry avg—reinforcing California lifestyle positioning.
Jogger battle: Vuori (150) vs Lululemon (109). Vuori leads by 41.
Neutrals (black/white/gray/navy) = 46% of Vuori's palette. Core basics that drive repeat purchases.
Vuori leads Lululemon in men's: 1341 vs 905 products. A 48% advantage.
Vuori ranks #3 in shorts with 561 products. Behind Gymshark (995).
Outerwear depth: Vuori has 489 products vs Lululemon's 376. Key for cooler weather expansion.
Market context: 24,163 competitor products tracked. Vuori's 3,497 = 13% share of tracked catalog.

alerts.message: On Running has 3x Vuori's catalog size
